-F.Name: -F
-F.description: Use the Finder API to move items to the trash

-s.Name: -s
-s.description: Securely empty the trash. trash asks for confirmation executing this action. If this argument is used, no need to be specified

-v.Name: -v
-v.description: Print verbose output while moving items

-y.Name: -y
-y.description: Skips the confirmation prompt for -e and -s. CAUTION: permanently instantly
